company_name: Tokyo University of Science, Sugiyama Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the Sugiyama Laboratory focuses on research and development of semiconductor materials and devices, particularly in the context of photovoltaics and sensors.
summary: Tokyo University of Science, Sugiyama Laboratory is engaged in research and development of advanced semiconductor devices, including solar cells and sensors, utilizing compound thin-film semiconductors. Their work emphasizes environmentally friendly technologies and the exploration of novel semiconductor materials.
capabilities: Development of CIGS, SnS, and CTS thin-film solar cells
Research on photocatalysts and IoT devices
Exploration of oxide materials like NiO, ZnO, SnO, and ITO
